{{Top|leg}}
A '''hub-buster''' was a type of blow that could be landed in [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]], a sport in which two competitors fought in [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]] while wearing [[shockmitt]]s and a shield-generating [[hub]]. The blow consisted of a strike to your opponent's hub with an ion-charged shockmitt, which would either disable their shield or, if their shield was already disabled, ionize their [[armor]], leading to them losing in an ion-out. A stunner to an unshielded hub could cause nerve-damage. The [[Calian]] shockboxer [[Lobar Aybock]] used a hub-buster to defeat the [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomian]] [[Tontruk]] and the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Tull Raine]] in different matches during his career.<ref name="Fists of Iron">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
